name: code-block
useFor: Use CodeBlock for a command, a config file or a snippet people copy. Give CodeBlockContent the text as code and its language (bash, tsx, ts, json, css); add CodeBlockCopyButton with the same text. Use lineNumbers for a file, wrap for long prose-like lines.
constraints: Syntax colors beyond the orange keywords
source: The Hoplite website's blog code blocks (.bp-code, .bp-code__bar, .bp-copy, .bp-code__pre)
title: Code Block
description: The blog's code block: a square frame of the quiet line, a 40px bar with the language as a Kode Mono label and a ruled-off Copy action, then Kode Mono code at 14px on 24px lines with keywords in the orange and comments in the slate. A tall file or long lines fade at the edge they scroll past (fade-xy; fade-y when lines wrap).
